rules.title: Maximum security deposit of one month's rent; optional fee in lieu of deposit
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a landlord may not require a security deposit greater than the first month's rent, and only if it is deposited and a statement of condition is given as required. The state housing office may authorize an optional fee in lieu of a deposit, but the fee plus any deposit may not exceed one month's rent in total.
rules.key_value: Security deposit capped at 1 month's rent; fee-in-lieu plus deposit capped at 1 month's rent
rules.quoted_span: (iii) a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2);
rules.coverage_text: Residential real property tenancies; excludes vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.
rules.exemptions: Leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purposes.
rules.penalty: Forfeiture of right to retain any portion of the deposit for listed violations; treble damages plus 5% interest, court costs and reasonable attorney's fees for violations of subsection 6(a), (d) or (e); lease provisions conflicting with the section are void.
rules.extraction_note: The document does not give an effective or enactment date for the deposit cap itself; the fee-in-lieu provision depends on regulations by the executive office of housing and livable communities, whose status is not stated.

rules.title: Security deposit held in separate interest-bearing account; receipts and annual interest
rules.requirement: A landlord must hold the deposit in a separate interest-bearing account at a Massachusetts bank, give a receipt with the bank and account details within 30 days, and pay the tenant interest annually at 5% or the lesser bank rate. Failure to comply with the account and receipt requirement entitles the tenant to immediate return of the deposit.
rules.key_value: Separate interest-bearing MA bank account; bank receipt within 30 days; interest at 5%/yr or lesser bank rate

rules.exemptions: Leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purposes.
rules.penalty: Immediate return of the security deposit; forfeiture of right to retain any portion; treble damages plus 5% interest, costs and attorney's fees for failure to deposit funds as required.

rules.title: Return of security deposit within 30 days; permitted deductions
rules.requirement: The landlord must return the deposit or balance within 30 days after the tenancy ends, deducting only unpaid rent or water charges, certain tax escalation amounts, and reasonable repair costs for tenant-caused damage beyond wear and tear, supported by a sworn itemized list. No other deductions are allowed.
rules.key_value: Return within 30 days; treble damages for noncompliance
rules.quoted_span: (4) The lessor shall, within thirty days after the termination of occupancy under a tenancy-at-will or the end of the tenancy as specified in a valid written lease agreement, return to the tenant the security deposit or any balance thereof;
rules.coverage_text: Residential real property tenancies; excludes vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.
rules.exemptions: Leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purposes.
rules.penalty: Forfeiture of right to retain any portion of the deposit or counterclaim for damage; damages of three times the deposit or balance plus 5% interest, court costs and reasonable attorney's fees.

rules.title: Limit on upfront charges at or before start of tenancy, including charges by lessor's agent
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, neither the landlord nor the landlord's agent may require a tenant or applicant to pay them anything beyond first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit of up to one month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock.
